Question 12

Consider the arc of the curve x=y22−1 that lies between the lines y=0 and y=1. Calculate the surface area generated when this arc is rotated 2π radians about the x-axis.

a
 2π3(22−1)
b
 32π2
c
 2π3
d
 2π(2−1)
e
 π(32−1)
